mission: To turn approved business requirements into reliable, production-ready automation systems that are delivered on time, built to spec, thoroughly tested, documented, and maintainable.
capacity: All time logged in ClickUp daily. Progress on active builds updated at least 3x per week; blockers escalated within 2 business hours of detection. Flag Grant and Savannah in advance if a week is trending past your contracted hours.

kpis.name: 1. Technical Rework Rate
kpis.calculation: Completed builds requiring rework because of avoidable technical design gaps ÷ total completed builds

kpis.name: 2. Escaped Defects
kpis.calculation: Defects discovered after the build has passed engineering QA and reached production/client use

kpis.name: 3. Definition of Done Compliance
kpis.calculation: Completed tickets meeting acceptance criteria, edge-case handling, test evidence, documentation, and business requirements ÷ total completed tickets

kpis.name: 4. Production Reliability
kpis.calculation: Time from production issue occurring to detection, and detection to resolution

kpis.name: 5. Documentation Completeness
kpis.calculation: Production systems with current technical documentation ÷ total production systems

outcomes.howMeasured: 100% of builds have a documented technical approach, data mapping, integrations, edge cases, and acceptance criteria before material build work begins; <10% of completed work requires rework due to avoidable technical design gaps
≥95% of assigned deliverables complete and QA'd ≥24h before the partner call; slippage only with a documented blocker, dependency, or approved scope change
≤2 escaped defects per client per month; 100% of applicable builds complete documented testing before being marked complete
Minimum time to discover ≤60 minutes and minimum time to resolve ≤12 working hours on monitored production flows; alerts, retries, and error handling configured where applicable
100% of tickets meet Definition of Done: acceptance criteria met, edge cases handled, test evidence attached, required documentation complete, and the client/business requirement satisfied

100% of production systems have current documentation including workflow logic, data mapping, dependencies, credentials/access requirements, error handling, and user-facing documentation where applicable
Progress updated at least 3x per week on active builds; blockers escalated within 2 business hours of detection; requirement questions raised within 1 business day of identifying ambiguity
≥1 meaningful automation, reliability, efficiency, or expansion opportunity per active client per month, documented with problem, expected impact, and recommended next step

competencies.body: Automation architecture and technical solution design.
Attention to detail across data mapping, edge cases, and idempotency.
Reliability patterns including retries, monitoring, alerting, and failure handling.
Data integrity and schema literacy across client systems.
Clear technical writing and asynchronous communication.

values.label: Build-Sharpen-Scale.
values.body: Turns solved technical problems into reusable modules, templates, SOPs, and patterns so future delivery becomes faster and more reliable.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Selects modern tools and technical approaches when they measurably improve reliability, speed, maintainability, or cost.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Owns the technical outcome end to end; flags risks early, fixes root causes rather than symptoms, and verifies systems work in the real environment.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Communicates status, blockers, technical limitations, and trade-offs plainly; pushes back on unclear requirements before building the wrong thing.
